hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Prime By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.

positive_snippets: Very nice place to stay. They provide prompt and fine services. I and family fully satisfied.
negative_snippets:
I booked this hotel for a daytime stay as we had a late-night flight. It was our first visit to Delhi, and due to heavy traffic, we were delayed by about two hours for checkout. The hotel charged us ₹1,500 for the booking and an additional ₹700 for the late checkout. We requested some flexibility considering the situation, but the staff did not accommodate our request.

Regarding the room, it was not well-maintained the walls had damp patches, there was no space to open the window, and the overall cleanliness was below expectations. The TV and telephone were not working, which added to the inconvenience. Despite these issues, we did not complain during the stay, but it certainly impacted the experience.

The stay served its purpose, but the lack of flexibility, poor maintenance, and non-functional amenities left us disappointed. Improving room conditions and customer service would make a significant difference

We stayed at this hotel for few days, and my experience was very disappointing. Every time I went out, the staff kept stopping me and asking how many people were going with me. Even if someone was just walking next to me, they would suddenly stop us and question it. This felt uncomfortable and unnecessary.

The room quality was very poor. The bed condition was terrible, and overall cleanliness and comfort were not up to standard.

The reception staff do not know how to talk to or behave with customers. Their attitude was rude and unprofessional throughout my stay.

Because of this experience, I will never stay at this hotel again and do not recommend it to others.

The place is nice but the way i left was really not nice...
I booked with the reception prepaid  taxi at night to the airport... I waited 20 min and it never arrived

Seems like the staff awake at the moment didn't know what was going on... luckily I got an uber. but if I didn't know  better I might would have missed my flight.

4 min before my uber came I asked the staff if I can get my money back... seems like the taxi didn't pick up the phone.

At start it looked like they don't know if I paid or not. I practically needed to beg them to get my money back to pay the uber taxi..and in general it didn't feel like they understood the urgency if getting to airport in time.
